    Search Processes with All Available Parameters

    search_processes.Rd

    Comprehensive search function that supports all documented DataJud API parameters. Build complex queries using any combination of available search criteria.

    search_processes(
  tribunal,
  id = NULL,
  numeroProcesso = NULL,
  grau = NULL,
  nivelSigilo = NULL,
  dataAjuizamento_start = NULL,
  dataAjuizamento_end = NULL,
  dataHoraUltimaAtualizacao_start = NULL,
  dataHoraUltimaAtualizacao_end = NULL,
  formato_codigo = NULL,
  formato_nome = NULL,
  sistema_codigo = NULL,
  sistema_nome = NULL,
  classe_codigo = NULL,
  classe_nome = NULL,
  assuntos_codigo = NULL,
  assuntos_nome = NULL,
  orgaoJulgador_codigo = NULL,
  orgaoJulgador_nome = NULL,
  orgaoJulgador_codigoMunicipioIBGE = NULL,
  movimentos_codigo = NULL,
  movimentos_nome = NULL,
  movimentos_dataHora_start = NULL,
  movimentos_dataHora_end = NULL,
  size = 10,
  parse = TRUE,
  api_key = NULL
)

    Arguments

    tribunal

    Character string with the tribunal (e.g., "trf1", "tjsp", "trt2"). Use list_tribunals() to see available options.

    id

    Character string with the process identifier.

    numeroProcesso

    Character string with the CNJ process number (without formatting).

    grau

    Character string with the court level/instance identifier (e.g., "G1" for first instance, "G2" for second instance).

    nivelSigilo

    Integer with the confidentiality level.

    dataAjuizamento_start

    Character string or Date for filing date range start (format: "YYYY-MM-DD").

    dataAjuizamento_end

    Character string or Date for filing date range end (format: "YYYY-MM-DD").

    dataHoraUltimaAtualizacao_start

    Character string or POSIXct for last update range start.

    dataHoraUltimaAtualizacao_end

    Character string or POSIXct for last update range end.

    formato_codigo

    Character string with the process type code.

    formato_nome

    Character string with the process type name.

    sistema_codigo

    Character string with the court system code.

    sistema_nome

    Character string with the court system name.

    classe_codigo

    Character string with the case classification code.

    classe_nome

    Character string with the case classification name.

    assuntos_codigo

    Character string with the case subject code.

    assuntos_nome

    Character string with the case subject name.

    orgaoJulgador_codigo

    Character string with the court body code.

    orgaoJulgador_nome

    Character string with the court body name.

    orgaoJulgador_codigoMunicipioIBGE

    Character string with the IBGE municipality code.

    movimentos_codigo

    Character string with the movement code.

    movimentos_nome

    Character string with the movement name.

    movimentos_dataHora_start

    Character string or POSIXct for movement date range start.

    movimentos_dataHora_end

    Character string or POSIXct for movement date range end.

    size

    Integer indicating the maximum number of results (default: 10, maximum: 10000).

    parse

    Logical indicating whether to parse the results into a data frame (default: TRUE).

    api_key

    Character string with the API key.

    Value

    If parse = TRUE, returns a tibble with the search results. If parse = FALSE, returns the raw API response as a list.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Set API key first
set_api_key(get_default_api_key())

# Search by grau and date range
results <- search_processes(
  tribunal = "trf1",
  grau = "G2",
  dataAjuizamento_start = "2020-01-01",
  dataAjuizamento_end = "2020-12-31"
)

# Search by subject and court body
results <- search_processes(
  tribunal = "trf1",
  assuntos_codigo = "10596",
  orgaoJulgador_nome = "1ª Turma"
)

# Search by class code and court body
results <- search_processes(
  tribunal = "trf1",
  classe_codigo = "1199",
  orgaoJulgador_nome = "1ª Turma"
)

# Complex search with multiple criteria
results <- search_processes(
  tribunal = "tjsp",
  classe_codigo = "1199",
  grau = "G2",
  sistema_nome = "PJe",
  nivelSigilo = 0
)
} # }
